name: @lp-labs/retry
description: Typed retry policies with abortable exponential backoff and jitter

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/write-cjs-package.cjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run clean:test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/write-test-cjs-package.cjs && node --test .test-dist/tests/*.test.js && npm run clean:test
